author: FqdedLights
body:
Hey there Avicus Network Staff, I am here writing to you regarding about my ban on your server.

IGN(s): FqdedLights, DinoTheG, BritishKid, Zhqnnon (FORGOT TO PUT ZHQNNON IN TITLE DIDNT FIT)
Why was I banned?: Hacked Client
Guilty?: Yes
Why do you want to be unbanned?:
I want to be unbanned because for starters I really enjoyed and loved playing on this amazing server, and all my moments and experiences I have had/made on this server was amazing. 
I was banned on all 4 accounts because I saw a video on JackSucksAtLife, TheCampingRusher, PrivateFearless, about hacking videos and stuff so I thought and decided I would hack so along I went on following the path, and as I put the client on and working out how to use it and so on, I came to a park where I found out and I joined this server so I joined it and within 10 minutes I was really happy like I wasn't doing anything and then 10 minutes after I got banned. I don't know why but I really enjoyed having that feeling that most hackers I guess would have. 
So I got banned and I was like no biggie I still got other accounts so I did same and I got banned after 1 hour or 2 I got bored felt really tired and had nothing to do.
So this is why I am appealing too apologise to your amazing network of what I have caused and what I have done to many other people to spoil games that they enjoy playing and cheating and having a higher advantage than most people. However, I am even more sorry for not following the rules and if I'm honest I'm not even going to lie about this because if anything I will get even more in trouble and I do not want that to happen. Most importantly, I am extremely sorry for ban evading because I could have easily just appealed once but no I'm appealing for all 4 which I know myself is extremely bad. Especially, when I'm already breaking most of the rules.
I am more than enough sorry for even breaking the rules and hacking and ban evading, and I make sure and promise to never happen again I have deleted the hacked client everything has gone off and I am never hacking ever again because of what it has just caused. I'm so sorry I know I should have not been hacking and I promise to never do it again. Eventhough, you guys may not believe me, I just want to say to give me a second chance and I can proove to you guys the real me, because this hacking isn't me I just wanted to have the feel and other things and instead it took me down the wrong path and I got banned. 
Please forgive me for everything I have caused I promise to never do it again and to play legit and never hack on any server again. Moreover, I just want to say I really love this network and staff members there all so nice and there helpful, and thank you guys ever so much for reading my Ban Appeal, hopefully I get unbanned and I will make your intentions about me turn around and hopefully you guys will know the real me afterwards, thank you for reading this Ban Appeal, have a great Summer! Regards - FqdedLights, DinoTheG, BritishKid, Zhqnnon!
